evidence_policy: Public page observations are not submission receipts. Only an organizer submission-page receipt can bind a score to a raster hash. No holdout or live score was produced by this review.

drivendata_problem.observation: Official target is fault prediction to support geothermal and critical-mineral studies; metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and a 300 m triangular kernel; submission raster requirements are described on the page. This is not direct geothermal-vent detection.

official_rules.observation: September 2026 DOE/NLR Official Rules. Sections 1.3 and 3.2 cover eligible competitors, registration and generative-AI disclosure; the rules describe up to three submissions per week under the platform limit and selection of one final submission for the prize phases. Public leaderboard scores can differ from private and expert-revised final evaluations. Section 3.3 says training features, labels, and a sample are provided to participants who agree to the competition terms and register; Appendix A.5 requires the competitor to have the necessary rights to use third-party content.

drivendata_data_page.observation: Official competition data page redirects to a login form for anonymous access. No credentials were requested or used.

competition_input_mirror_audit.observation: The manifest has pinned GitHub mirror routes for competition-provided and derived inputs, and the default restore path fetches from those routes when files are absent. Only restore_data.py --check was run; it checks actual local files and hashes without network fetching. Authorization/provenance of mirror copies remains unverified.

public_leaderboard.evidence_class: OFFICIAL PUBLIC-LEADERBOARD SNAPSHOT; NOT A SUBMISSION-PAGE RECEIPT FOR ANY NINE-SITE FILE

usgs_sgmc.observation: Official USGS release page and NGMDB DOI landing page fetched; NGMDB page exposes a GeMS GIS-data download link. The release is identified as CC0. No GIS bytes, exact AOI coverage, fields, or local rasterization were checked.

usgs_comcat.observation: Official API returned event records for a broad Nevada-California bounding box. It does not establish complete event coverage or focal-mechanism density inside the competition footprint. The response was inspected, but no event dataset was saved or ingested into the repository.

usgs_3dep.observation: USGS states 3DEP lidar/DEM products are free with no use restrictions. Exact 1 m tile coverage for the competition footprint was not checked and no tiles were acquired.

usgs_landsat_surface_temperature.observation: USGS describes global scene-based Collection 2 surface-temperature products with no use restrictions. Exact scenes, cloud-free coverage, date comparability, and footprint intersection were not checked; no scenes were acquired.

nine_focus_sites.observation: The latest local pinned byte/peer audit labels all nine score values USER-REPORTED, has no organizer-confirmed score, and does not claim a complete organizer registry. The current owner-maintained site pages were checked for submission authorization; they are not organizer receipts.
